title: EngramPack artifact walkthrough
summary: Create and inspect an artifact-only record pack containing three original synthetic CC0 tutorial triples: atlas maps_to beacon, beacon maps_to amber, and cipher maps_to delta. These records are tutorial material, not a sealed card, dynamic-world dataset, or executable model memory.

steps.explanation: Write records.jsonl with the three original synthetic CC0 provenance-marked tutorial records, then compile it with a fixed created-at value.
shapes: three JSONL records: atlas → beacon, beacon → amber, cipher → delta
observe: record count and explicit CC0 tutorial provenance

steps.explanation: Use existing pack commands to compile, inspect, and verify the immutable artifact; do not present the records as executable semantic retrieval.

prerequisites: Use engram pack compile, inspect, and verify with fixed created-at 2026-09-23T00:00:00Z.
try_changes: Predict which three records appear after inspection.
Change one original tutorial record and verify that the artifact identity changes.
Do not attach this artifact to a model or claim semantic execution.
limits: This lesson creates no model.yaml and has no probe.
The synthetic CC0 records are not a sealed evaluation card, a dynamic-world dataset, or evidence of model behavior.
